entries.en: My daddy has a better job than your dad!
entries.ro: Tata are o slujbă mai bună decât a ta!

entries.en: I'm a princess and you're not, la la la la-laaa la!

entries.en: Hey, don't yell at me…! You're not allowed to…! You're not my dad!

entries.en: Huh, I-I don’t wanna…! I won't go…! Ugh, fine…! I hate you, anyway!
entries.ro: Huh, nu vreau…! Nu plec…! Ugh, bine…! Te urăsc, oricum!

entries.en: Huh I don't wanna…! Don't wannaaaah hah hah!
entries.ro: Huh, nu vreau…! Nu vreaaaau hah hah!

entries.en: Waah heh heh... I want my brother… let me go…
entries.ro: Waah heh heh... Vreau fratele meu… lasă-mă să plec…

entries.en: You're not s'posed to look at me!
entries.ro: Nu ai voie să te uiți la mine!

entries.en: Heh, no way…! My real dad will beat you up! Ye-yeah, you'll see!
entries.ro: Heh, nici vorbă…! Tatăl meu adevărat o să te bată! Da-da, o să vezi!
